moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 用于开始报价的标准报价：其行按报价自身日期为客户计价。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: Summarize this deal: its stage, amount, people, activities and what is next
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 汇总此交易：阶段、金额、人员、活动以及下一步

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: The cost and margin are shown to a reader of product costs: a finance reader who reads costs, or one who reads both prices and costs.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 成本和毛利向可阅读产品成本的人显示：阅读成本的财务读者，或同时阅读价格和成本的人。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: The lost reasons are shared by every organization; an administrator of every organization changes them.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 丢单原因由所有组织共用；全部组织的管理员才能更改。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: The one kept gets the other's contact details, contacts, relationships, opportunities, orders, agreements, files and history; the other is disabled. The one kept keeps its own name.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 保留的一方获得另一方的联系方式、联系人、关系、商机、订单、协议、文件和历史；另一方被禁用。保留的一方保持自己的名称。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: The orders due while it is paused are skipped
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 暂停期间到期的订单会被跳过

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: The organization's currency when empty; a quote from the template is in it
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 留空时用组织的货币；从模板生成的报价使用该货币

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: The organization's quote validity when empty
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 留空时用组织的报价有效期

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: The part after + in sales+tag@; empty takes no mail
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: sales+tag@ 中 + 之后的部分；留空则不接收邮件

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: The quote's author may approve it
The shared pipeline is changed by an administrator of every organization; create a pipeline of your own to change its stages.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 共享管道由全部组织的管理员更改；要更改阶段，请创建自己的管道。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: The template's or the organization's when empty
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 留空时用模板的或组织的

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: The warehouse, store or plant of the organization a new quote or order ships from; it can be changed on the order

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: The year, its four quarters and twelve months, those the organization does not have yet.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 该年、四个季度和十二个月中组织尚没有的那些。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: This contact is not available: it does not exist, or it is not an account or a contact of an account you may see.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 此联系人不可用：不存在，或不是您可以查看的客户账户或其联系人。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: This organization has no sales periods yet. A sales manager adds them under Settings › Targets.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 此组织尚无销售期间。销售经理在设置 › 目标下添加。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: This organization has no sales periods yet: add this year's first.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 此组织尚无销售期间：请添加今年的第一批。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: This organization is not available to you, or its settings cannot be read just now.

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: This organization is not available to you, or its sources cannot be read just now.

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: This quote needs no approval at its current revision.
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 此报价的当前修订不需要审批。

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: Warranty claims whose repair Customer Service will charge for: make the estimate's quote from the claim's lines. Nothing of the claim but its customer and products is shown here.

moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.original: Yes: a request made from mail is answered once, to the address it came from, with its reference, when the sender is a contact or account of yours
moqui.basic.LocalizedMessage.localized: 是：从邮件生成的询价，在发件人是您的联系人或客户账户时，只回复一次到其来源地址并附上参考号
